varianceCorrection.equation: B_c(p,q)=sum_r alpha(p+r)*alpha(q+r)*(v_c(p+r)+v_c(q+r)-2cov_c(p+r,q+r))/sum_r coverage. This draft sets covariance to 0 for distinct source samples and sets the entire pair bias to 0 when clamping maps to the identical source sample. Corrected D_L=max(D_L-B_L,0), D_C=max(D_C-B_A-B_B,0).
varianceCorrection.rangeAblation: Correct only D_L in the luminance range term and D_C in the chroma range term; preserve raw fixed-guidance distances.
varianceCorrection.guidanceAblation: Correct only D_C in luminance guidance and D_L in chroma guidance; preserve raw range distances.
varianceCorrection.both: Correct distances in range and fixed-guidance terms. Bandwidths and spatial/self weights remain unchanged.
varianceCorrection.limits: Variance sum is an IID approximation for distinct samples. Demosaic, lens correction and clipping introduce correlation and heteroscedasticity. Oracle coefficients cannot ship as an estimator.

globalEstimator.domain: Full authenticated prepared reference-WB/lens Float32 Rec.2020 source; asinh luminance/opponent features. Never visible ROI, viewport, crop, zoom or embedded JPEG.
globalEstimator.sampling: Enumerate valid pair origins row-major for each direction; select floor((i+0.5)*N/M), i=0..M-1, M=min(N,65536). No random or content-dependent sample selection.
globalEstimator.alphaWeight: product of the pair alpha values; discard zero weight before all medians; require at least16 valid pairs for a direction
globalEstimator.medianConvention: Weighted lower cumulative median; when cumulative weight is exactly one half, mean the two adjacent positive-weight values.
globalEstimator.componentEstimate: MAD of centered feature differences divided by (0.6744897501960817*sqrt(2)); square for variance. Conservative minimum across valid directions for each feature coordinate.
globalEstimator.noSamples: zero variance, explicitly reported unavailable; no invented calibration
globalEstimator.freeze: Compute once in CPU Float64 per prepared-source/estimator identity and share the exact frozen coefficients with CPU/GPU. All-zero controls skip estimation and preserve bytes.
globalEstimator.limits: Empirical semantic, not unbiased or calibrated. The minimum is biased downward; finite/overlapping/correlated samples, clipping and texture can bias it. A global estimate cannot describe every local noise level or a4:1 merge boundary.
